c.v: Philips specifications require that WS signal changes one BCK clock cycle earlier than SD signal on BCK falling edge, which means that WS signal is valid from one clock cycle before transmitting the first bit of channel data and changes one clock before the end of channel data transfer.
SD signal line transmits the most significant bit of audio data first.
Compared with Philips standard, TDM Philips standard supports multiple channels, see Figure 28.5-1.
